implemented: SQL Server connection config with ODBC driver, encryption mode, and trust-server-certificate fields.
SQL Server adapter URL construction, engine options, connection test, schema inspection, T-SQL explain hook, and experimental read-only limitation.
Adapter registry entry hidden from default catalog and exposed only when server-side experimental catalog flag is enabled.
Adapter-key-aware config coercion so default ports and adapter-specific fields are applied correctly.
T-SQL AST golden coverage for TOP, OFFSET FETCH, bracket quoting, CTEs, windows, joins, and aggregates.

blocked_or_deferred.reason: No SQL Server CI service/container and ODBC driver stack are configured yet.
SQL Server has no portable session-level read-only switch; verification needs a permission-scoped login in real integration infrastructure.
Dialect eval promotion requires a real SQL Server fixture and execution-match runner before release_state can move from experimental to verified.

release_recommendation: Keep SQL Server experimental; do not expose to normal Add Connection flow yet.
